title: Document
summary: Render the SSR document and reconcile its client-side language and theme classes.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Accepts DocumentProps: HTML attributes and children, plus an optional boolean data-debug attribute. Pass an explicit lang value for accessible server markup.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Both server renderers emit the html element. React hydrates that element natively; Preact returns its children in the browser and reconciles document attributes through its document integration.

sections.title: Root layout
sections.body: Use Document in the root module's Layout component. Keep metadata, links, and hydration scripts in that layout so the server and browser render the same document structure.

sections.title: Hydration and subsequent changes
sections.body: Hydration preserves theme classes added before mounting. Subsequent className changes replace only the prior managed classes. React reconciles the html element and its other attributes natively; Preact explicitly synchronizes lang, className and data-debug.

sections.title: Externally injected head elements
sections.body: Mark externally owned direct children of head with data-smolter-preserve and do not also render them in the application. Preact temporarily excludes marked nodes from hydration; React 19 uses native head reconciliation. Both integrations test preserved script identity/execution and styles across navigation. Arbitrary body injection and hydration-payload changes remain unsupported.
